text.en: These Regulations may be cited as the Employment (Domestic Workers) Regulations.

heading.en: Application of certain provisions of Employment Act to domestic workers

text.en: The duration which may be stipulated or implied in any contract of service involving a journey from the place of recruitment to the place of employment shall not exceed 3 years.
